name: Chuan Xiang Flavor 川湘百味
reviews: 风味茄子给到夯……太香了，有水平
Ordered takeaway. Thought I'd give this new place a try as my usual was closed. My usual Chinese just lost a customer. The food here was excellent.
A new restaurant in our building, and so far, whatever we tried has been finger-licking great! 🥢❤️
